president-and-vice-president.note: Counted by ranked choice (21-A MRS section 723-A); the votes shown are first choices. The leader had more than half of the first choices for the candidates and write-ins, a majority no later round could take away, so the leader is marked elected. Maine chooses two presidential electors statewide and one in each congressional district. The district rows are the Secretary of State's tabulation by congressional district.
